_doc: Trade evolutions made in-game (trade_evos agent, 2026-10-07; installed by b2tools/patches/trade_evos.py).
evolutions: every species of Black 2's evolution table a/0/1/9 that had a trade method gets this full list of
evolutions instead (names from the decomp: include/constants/pokemon.h EVO_METHOD_*, items.h, species.h).
Methods as CheckEvolveSpecies (arm9 0x02020788) handles them: EVO_METHOD_TRADE 5 / TRADE_WITH_ITEM 6 /
TRADE_WITH_SPECIES 7 are only checked in its trade mode (1); LEVEL 4 (level >= param) and SPECIES_IN_PARTY 22
(CheckSpeciesInParty, no level needed) in its level-up mode (0); ITEM 8 (param == the item used) in its item
Plain trade -> LEVEL at the previous stage's evolution level + 10 (Kadabra: 36, the user's choice). Trade holding an item -> ITEM: the item is
used from the Bag like an evolution stone. Karrablast/Shelmet -> SPECIES_IN_PARTY (as Mantyke/Remoraid), with
the partner's evolved form accepted too, so the second one can still evolve after the first.
Branches keep their other evolution (Poliwhirl Water Stone, Slowpoke Lv 37, Feebas Beauty 170).
bag_items: every item an ITEM evolution above uses gets the Bag 'Use' of an evolution stone in its item data
(a/0/2/4: +0xA field use 20, +0xC party use 1, +0x11 bit 3 = evolve), and stays holdable.
shop: items appended to a Hoenn shop list (b2tools/patches/shops.py ids): the items Hoenn has no other source for,
and Metal Coat / Dragon Scale (otherwise only 5% wild held items; user's choice): Lilycove Dept. Store 3F, right
clerk (id 15, X items). Black 2's own prices (item data). a/2/8/2 is then exactly its fixed 1300 bytes: no room left.
